consumerProgram: const fs=await import('node:fs');const {createHash}=await import('node:crypto');const {execFileSync}=await import('node:child_process');const {homedir}=await import('node:os');const config=JSON.parse(process.argv[1]);const sha=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');const memoryMax=fs.readFileSync('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max','utf8').trim(),cpuMax=fs.readFileSync('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max','utf8').trim();if(memoryMax!=='2147483648'||cpuMax.split(' ').map(Number)[0]/cpuMax.split(' ').map(Number)[1]!==2)throw new Error('Observed cgroup bounds differ');const fixtureChecks=[];for(const [index,row]of config.fixtures.entries()){const body=fs.readFileSync(homedir()+'/Seafile/Plain/Text/Reference/Figma export/'+row.name);if(body.length!==row.bytes||sha(body)!==row.sha256)throw new Error('Injected private fixture identity differs');fixtureChecks.push({index,bytes:body.length,identityMatched:true});}const calls=[];for(const row of config.files){if(sha(fs.readFileSync('/workspace/'+row.path))!==row.sha256)throw new Error('Frozen authored test differs');const startedAt=new Date().toISOString();try{const stdout=execFileSync(process.execPath,[row.path],{cwd:'/workspace',encoding:'utf8',maxBuffer:16*1024*1024,timeout:60000});calls.push({file:row.path,startedAt,finishedAt:new Date().toISOString(),exitCode:0,stdout,stderr:''});}catch(error){calls.push({file:row.path,startedAt,finishedAt:new Date().toISOString(),exitCode:error.status,signal:error.signal,stdout:String(error.stdout??''),stderr:String(error.stderr??''),error:String(error.message)});}}console.log(JSON.stringify({source:config.source,node:process.version,memoryMax,cpuMax,fixtureChecks,calls}));if(calls.some(row=>row.exitCode!==0))process.exitCode=1;
